title: Client Salesforce admin for the admin handoff was never named; 'Admin Handoff' epic WAGR-22 holds no tickets

transcript_evidence.speakers: Waleed Alasadi; Joyce Kiddell; Emily Vandenberg
transcript_evidence.quote: Joyce Kiddell: Yeah, I think we're still talking internally about like who exactly. / Joyce Kiddell: Um, but the plan would be once we get past discovery, um, we would want to bring in that person to kind of ride along through the process. / Emily Vandenberg: We wanted to keep it to the main like business kind of like stakeholders in this in this round. / Waleed Alasadi: That's totally fair.

Waleed Alasadi: you're a small company so yes Eric is going to own it and have something but yes there's something to be spoken about change management but you should be empowered to go and add a field because all of a sudden we need to track this

Waleed Alasadi: Okay. Um, he should definitely start learning Salesforce. So, there's Trailblazers. / Waleed Alasadi: and he should work towards becoming a a Salesforce administrator and then towards an advanced Salesforce

what_differs: At kickoff WagerTech said it would bring in its future Salesforce admin after discovery, but who that is was still being decided; Jumpr recommended Eric learn Salesforce (Trailhead/Admin cert) and own simple changes. No later meeting names the admin or plans the handoff, and Jira's handoff epic is empty.
suggested_action: Suggestion only: raise at the next weekly sync who the WagerTech admin is and when they join; then add handoff tickets (admin manual, permission-set guide, BA setup runbook WAGR-186 handover).
